body:
The manager is also reportedly in advanced talks to acquire GIC and Silver Lake Partners' stakes in the breakdown recovery service provider, alongside other investors.

The sale comes almost four years after Ufenau transferred the equine veterinary group into a €563 million multi-asset CV.

The potential vehicle follows Antin's July agreement to sell ~30% of the asset to GLIL Infrastructure from its €3.6 billion Fund III.

Quilvest Capital Partners also participated in the single-asset CV for a UK-based logistics solutions company.

The continuation fund, managed by Victory Hill, will hold two operating liquid storage terminals in the Port of Brownsville.

The single-asset vehicle extends B2B software investor Viking Growth's hold on a recruitment and HR software platform.

Potential backers reportedly sought a lower valuation for the loans held in the continuation fund.

The single-asset deal centers on a health and social care software provider first backed by Activa in 2019.
